name: FORNO® 24" Stainless Steel Commercial Natural Gas Griddle
shortDescription: This 24 Inch Commercial Gas Griddle delivers 60,000 BTUs of cooking power with two burners and a heavy duty 1 inch carbon steel griddle plate. Built from durable stainless steel 430, it features a 33-inch depth for a larger cooking area, fully welded splash guards, and a cool to the touch stainless steel front edge. An easy-to-remove 4.5 quart grease drawer with weep hole simplifies cleanup, while adjustable non-skid feet ensure stability. Designed for natural gas with a standing pilot ignition system, this griddle also includes an LP conversion kit for versatile installation in restaurants, diners, and food trucks.

features.text: 24 inch commercial gas griddle with 60,000 BTUs for high volume cooking
Two burners with independent controls for even heat distribution
Heavy duty 1 inch carbon steel griddle plate ensures consistent cooking and durability
33 inch depth provides extra cooking area for restaurants, diners, and food trucks
Stainless steel 430 construction for long-lasting performance and easy cleaning
Fully welded back and side splash guards contain grease and food spills
Cool to the touch stainless steel front edge enhances operator safety
Easy to remove 4.5 quart grease drawer with weep hole for fast cleanup
Adjustable stainless steel non-skid feet provide stability on any surface
Standing pilot ignition system ensures reliable startup and consistent performance
Natural gas configuration with included LP conversion kit for flexible installation
Ideal for commercial kitchens, food trucks, cafeterias, and catering operations
